covenants.name: Creation (Adam)
covenants.description: A theological term for God's arrangement with Adam in the garden, drawn from Genesis 1-3 and Romans 5:12-21. The word "covenant" does not appear in Genesis 1-3.

covenants.name: Noah
covenants.description: God's covenant with Noah, his offspring and every living creature, with the rainbow as its sign.

covenants.name: Abraham
covenants.description: God's covenant with Abram/Abraham, with circumcision as its sign, explained by Paul in Romans 4.

covenants.name: Moses (Sinai)
covenants.description: Placeholder for the covenant at Sinai; passages outside Genesis and Romans are added in a later phase.

covenants.name: David
covenants.description: Placeholder for the covenant with David; passages outside Genesis and Romans are added in a later phase.

covenants.name: New covenant
covenants.description: Placeholder for the new covenant; passages outside Genesis and Romans are added in a later phase.
